text: The Patriots are weathering the injury storm after improving to 2-0 in the AFC East with a 26-19 victory over the Jets, though the win came at considerable cost: WR Romeo Doubs suffered a shoulder injury on a 42-yard touchdown catch from Drake Maye early in the first quarter and has been placed on injured reserve, prompting the team to sign DB Elliott Davison to the 53-man roster and add WR Ryan Miller, OL Jacob Rizy, and G Andrew Rupcich to the practice squad while releasing CB D'Shawn Jamison. Despite Drake Maye's three touchdown passes steering the Patriots to their third consecutive win, A.J. Brown's return from a four-week absence following a right high ankle sprain proved rocky, as the receiver dropped a career-high three passes in his first game back. Head Coach Mike Vrabel's message to the locker room remains steadfast: never apologize for a win, and the Patriots are sticking to that philosophy as they prepare for Week 7 against the Bears.
